description: This file defines the interface for a scheduler component, including data structures, function prototypes for initializing, deinitializing, adding, canceling, updating, executing, and managing timer tasks within a scheduler system.

methods.name: scheduler_init
methods.description: Initializes and returns a new scheduler instance.

methods.name: scheduler_deinit
methods.description: Terminates the scheduler and releases resources.

methods.name: scheduler_add_timer_task
methods.description: Adds a new timer task to the scheduler with specified parameters.

methods.name: scheduler_cancel_timer_task
methods.description: Cancels a scheduled timer task by its ID.

methods.name: scheduler_update_timer_task_interval
methods.description: Updates the interval of an existing timer task.

methods.name: scheduler_timer_task_is_completed
methods.description: Checks if a timer task has completed all repetitions or was canceled.

methods.name: scheduler_update_timer_task_repetitions
methods.description: Updates the number of repetitions for a timer task.

methods.name: scheduler_execute
methods.description: Runs the scheduler, processing scheduled tasks within a timeout period.

methods.name: scheduler_free_timer_task_arg
methods.description: Frees the argument associated with a timer task, if allocated.

methods.name: scheduler_update_timeout
methods.description: Delays a timer task by updating its timeout value.
